items.source: As an alternative to implementing and registering a TestRuntimeHintsRegistrar, you may choose to annotate a test class with @Reflective, @RegisterReflection, or @ImportRuntimeHints.
items.translation: 作为实现和注册 `TestRuntimeHintsRegistrar`` 的替代方案，您可以选择使用 `@Reflective`、@RegisterReflection 或 @ImportRuntimeHints 注解测试类。

items.source: This API serves as a companion to the core RuntimeHintsRegistrar API. If you need to register global hints for testing support that are not specific to particular test classes, favor implementing RuntimeHintsRegistrar over this API.
items.translation: 此 API 作为核心RuntimeHintsRegistrarAPI 的补充。如果您需要注册用于测试支持的通用全局提示（这些提示不特定于某个特定的测试类），请优先实现RuntimeHintsRegistrar，而不是使用此 API。

items.source: Implementations of this interface must be registered statically in META-INF/spring/aot.factories by using the fully qualified name of this interface as the key. A standard no-arg constructor is required for implementations.
items.translation: 此接口的实现必须通过使用该接口的完全限定名作为键，在 `META-INF/spring/aot.factories` 中静态注册。实现类需要一个标准的无参构造函数。

items.source: Contribute hints to the given RuntimeHints instance.
items.translation: 向给定的 `RuntimeHints` 实例贡献提示。
